lemma split_at_zero (k : ℕ) :

  2 ^ (k + 1) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (k + 2), 2 ^ (k + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (k + 1 + j) j := by
  have h_finset : Finset.Icc 0 (k + 1) = {0} ∪ Finset.Ico 1 (k + 2) := by
    ext x
    simp [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> simp_all [Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    <;> omega

lemma expand_tail (k : ℕ) :
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (k + 2), 2 ^ (k + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (k + 1 + j) j = 
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (k + 2), 2 ^ (k + 1 - j) * (Nat.choose (k + j) j + Nat.choose (k + j) (j - 1)) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl]
  intro j hj
  have h : 1 ≤ j := by simp_all [Finset.mem_Ico]
  rw [← pascal_for_sum k j h]

lemma distribute_sum (k : ℕ) :
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (k + 2), 2 ^ (k + 1 - j) * (Nat.choose (k + j) j + Nat.choose (k + j) (j - 1)) = 
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (k + 2), 2 ^ (k + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (k + 2), 2 ^ (k + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) (j - 1) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => mul_add _ _ _]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
